title: PJM Reliability Backstop Procurement central bid window opens (FERC ER26-3380)
source: NEWS: utilitydive.com/news/pjm-backstop-capacity-auction-ferc-data-centers/826792/ fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200) — reports PJM filed the Reliability Backstop Procurement at FERC on 2026-07-31 under docket ER26-3380-000, with the central bid window running 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-21, a $555/MW-day price cap (vs the $325/MW-day RPM collar cap) and a $20B maximum procurement budget against the 6,831 MW shortfall from the 2028/29 BRA. Corroborated on the window-open date by cpvretail.com/2026/08/14/pjm-reliability-backstop-procurement-what-you-should-know/ (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200: 'the auction is expected to begin September 30, 2026', commitments 'up to 15 years', resources operating by 2032-06-01) and by foleyhoag.com's 2026-07 note on the PJM Board's 2026-07-27 decisional letter ('will begin in September 2026'). Filed estimate on three counts: no FERC order accepting ER26-3380 was found on any search run 2026-09-08, PJM's own posted RPM page (pjm.com/markets-and-operations/rpm, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200) carries no RBP schedule at all, and the window opening is expressly CONDITIONAL — PJM has said it intends to open on 2026-09-30 only if the framework is accepted by 2026-09-29. Also this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The PJM Inside Lines RBP article returned an EMPTY body to WebFetch this session and is recorded in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked
notes: DISCOVERED during the pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-08). Why it earns a row: it is the upstream half of the December capacity sequence this calendar already tracks. The 2029/30 Base Residual Auction (pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12, ~2026-12-15 est.) sits inside a $325/MW-day collar that FERC accepted 2026-04-28, so its clearing price is a known number; the RBP is a SEPARATE, one-time procurement at a $555/MW-day cap, which is the first PJM auction since the collar era began that can print a price above $325. That makes this window — not the December BRA — where price discovery on new PJM supply actually happens. Conditional on FERC accepting ER26-3380 by 2026-09-29; a rejection, a deficiency letter or a delay past that date slips or kills this event and is itself the kill switch on the proposing ledger's revised sequencing read. Impact medium and symbols empty on the same grounds the proposing ledger records: none of the nine tracked names is an IPP, the exposed names (VST/CEG/TLN/NRG) live in docs/research/ai-energy-constraint.md rather than on the tracked roster, and no house playbook is keyed to a capacity auction (the proposing ledger's Leg 5, 2026-08-17). Estimate — nothing here licenses a date-keyed entry.
